faults.page says: The recruitment page calls Paris Musées an établissement public à caractère administratif created by the Ville de Paris; the establishment page says it is an établissement public local with legal and financial autonomy, replacing management of the museums en régie directe. It is a separate public body, not a department of the city.

faults.stored: Governance: Paris Musées' recruitment page calls it an administrative public body created by the Ville de Paris that recruits civil servants and, for temporary missions, contract agents.
faults.page says: Does not mention the legal and financial autonomy that the establishment page gives as the reason it is a separate public body
faults.fix: Governance: Paris Musées' recruitment page calls it an administrative public body created by the Ville de Paris that recruits civil servants and, for temporary missions, contract agents, and its establishment page calls it a local public body with its own legal and financial autonomy.

corrected.basis: Governance: Paris Musées' recruitment page calls it an administrative public body created by the Ville de Paris that recruits civil servants and, for temporary missions, contract agents, and its establishment page calls it a local public body with its own legal and financial autonomy.
